title: Projects
description: Here are a few projects that showcase my work and creativity. While there are many more, I’ve curated a selection to keep this portfolio concise and focused.

items.title: HW-OCR Deposit Form
items.description: Designed and implemented a high-accuracy handwritten OCR system for bank deposit forms by integrating computer vision, object detection, and transformer-based OCR models.

items.title: Multi-Tenant HR Product
items.description: Designed and built a scalable HRMS with dynamic URN-based routing and UUID-driven data isolation, supporting secure multi-tenant workflows and high-performance operations.

items.title: Civil Dept Product - CAD
items.description: Designed and contributed to a CAD-centric civil engineering product focused on digital construction workflows, drawing management, and project collaboration—conceptually aligned with tools like industry-standard CAD and BIM platforms.

items.title: Blog Publishing Platform
items.description: Created a full-featured content platform with authentication, rich text editing, nested comments, moderation tools, and scalable deployment on AWS.

items.title: Insurance Product
items.description: Built a secure insurance platform featuring policy management, claims processing, role-based access, chatbot assistance, and online payments with real-time transaction tracking.

items.title: CMA Firm Website
items.description: Designed and developed a modern, strategy-driven corporate website for a CMA firm, translating complex financial services into a clear, trust-focused digital experience using Figma, MCP servers, and Next.js.
